description: AURASATH 6.1.1 — Flagship Release. Liquid Glass UI, full YouTube Music streaming, synced lyrics, Spotify account login & dual Wrapped playback sync, universal playlist & album importer, smart shuffle, and Discord Rich Presence.

changelog.title: Smart Sleep Fade & Audio Polish
items: Smart Sleep Fade: Sleep timer and 'pause at end of track' now gently fade volume over the final 8-10 seconds to 0 before pausing, restoring volume seamlessly for next session.
Silky 120fps tab transitions: replaced heavy sliding layout shifts across Home, Library, and Settings with ultra-fluid hardware-accelerated crossfades.
Swipe-to-Play-Next: swipe right on any playlist or library song to immediately queue it next with haptic confirmation.
FastScroller Polish: resolved corrupted characters and removed 27-dot synthetic rail clutter on custom order playlists.
Foldable & Tablet Optimization: intelligent split-view player and navigation rail activation for screens wider than 600dp.
YouTube Playlist Stability: stripped duplicate 'VL' prefixes preventing 400/404 API errors and added robust fallback endpoints.

changelog.title: Tamil Music Priority & Regional Feed
items: Home screen Featured card, Quick picks, and Daily Discover now fully prioritize Tamil trending songs and adapt directly to your imported Spotify Tamil playlists.
Automatic Hindi & Bollywood shelf filter: removes non-Tamil regional spam when Tamil content preference is active, and introduces a dedicated 'Tamil Hits & Trending' shelf.

changelog.title: Track Selection & Queue Fallback Fix
items: Resolved playlist and home screen fallback bug where tapping a specific song (e.g. 4th track) defaulted to playing the 1st song of the automix.
Audio stream resolver now guarantees exact track ID matching across JioSaavn, Tidal, and YouTube playback.

changelog.title: Flagship Launch (v6.1.1)
items: Welcome to the flagship release of AURASATH — the premier open-source music player with Liquid Glass aesthetic.
Ad-free background streaming and offline caching powered by YouTube Music and ExoPlayer Media3.
Official Discord Rich Presence integration displaying live playback, album art, and artist details.

changelog.title: Universal Playlist & Album Importer
items: Import playlists and albums from Spotify, Apple Music, and Amazon Music simply by pasting their public share links.
High-accuracy track matching with automatic HTML entity unescaping, cover art retrieval, and instant progress dialogs.
Batch database insertion and in-memory search query caching for blazing-fast imports without freezing playback or UI.

changelog.title: Spotify Account & Dual Wrapped Sync
items: Connect your Spotify account directly in Settings > Account alongside YouTube Music with one-tap login/logout.
Dual Wrapped Playback Sync: songs played in AURASATH now automatically sync with both your YouTube Music Recap and Spotify Wrapped / Recently Played.
Completely fixed Spotify Liked Songs import with robust OAuth token refreshing and multi-tier GraphQL fallback.

changelog.title: Smart Shuffle & Infinite Genre Automix
items: Fixed shuffle loop issue where single tracks repeated indefinitely: turning on shuffle now dynamically spins up an automix of similar genre and style tracks.
Fixed single-track queues by linking YouTube Automix radio (RDAMVM) and related genre tracks automatically across Search, Home, and Suggestions.
Seamless Autoplay: when reaching the end of a queue with Repeat Off, AURASATH automatically loads more tracks of the same genre so your music never abruptly stops.

changelog.title: Visual Engine & Cover Art Overhaul
items: Crystal-clear high-resolution album art: eliminated blurry/pixelated thumbnails across YouTube Music and Spotify feeds by dynamically serving up to 800x800 and 640x640 covers.
Smooth hero art tinting: removed pitch-black screen flashes when navigating into albums and artist pages.
Solid Apple Music-inspired elevated dock for keyboard search bar, eliminating distorted background shaders.

changelog.title: Audio Playback & Stability
items: Instant crossfade activation: changes to crossfade toggles and duration immediately apply to the actively playing song without requiring track restarts.
Fixed device-specific font variation crashes on Vivo, Honor, Motorola, Samsung, and Realme devices.
Optimized gapless transition detection.
